description: This Java class 'AccountStorage' provides utility methods for persisting and retrieving an account number in an Android application. It uses SharedPreferences for persistent storage and includes thread safety measures.

classes.name: AccountStorage
classes.description: A utility class for storing and retrieving account numbers persistently in Android.

methods.name: SetAccount
methods.description: Stores the provided account number string into SharedPreferences and updates the in-memory cached value, with thread safety.

methods.name: GetAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the account number, returning the cached value if available; otherwise, reads from SharedPreferences with thread safety.
